verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RustDesk Server Pro offers a management API, but nothing documents a downloadable machine-readable spec for it, such as an OpenAPI or equivalent file. Having an API is related but is not the spec the story asks for. The llms.txt file is a product summary, not an API description.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
